title: Noisy-Space Policy Gradient for Diffusion Policies in Offline Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.06882v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion policies offer a powerful and expressive parameterization for continuous control. Yet, their integration with reinforcement learning remains conceptually and algorithmically challenging. In this work, we address this gap by introducing a noisy-space action-value (Q-)function that assigns values to diffusion latents through the distribution of executed actions induced by the denoising process. We show that this construction admits a precise semantic interpretation and derive a noisy-space policy gradient (NSPG) that optimizes noisy latents using only clean action-space value estimates. Building on this result, we formulate a KL-regularized policy improvement over noisy latents and show that the resulting objective admits a diffusion-compatible regression form, avoiding backpropagation through the denoising process. translated_title: 离线强化学习中扩散策略的噪声空间策略梯度
translated_abstract: 扩散策略为连续控制提供了一种强大且富有表现力的参数化方法。然而，将其与强化学习相结合在概念和算法层面仍然充满挑战。在这项工作中，我们通过引入一种噪声空间动作值（Q-）函数来弥补这一空白，该函数通过去噪过程所诱导的执行动作分布为扩散潜变量赋值。我们证明这一构造具有精确的语义解释，并据此推导出一种噪声空间策略梯度（NSPG），它仅需使用干净动作空间的值估计即可优化噪声潜变量。基于这一结果，我们构建了针对噪声潜变量的KL正则化策略改进方法，并证明所得到的目标函数具有与扩散模型兼容的回归形式，从而避免了通过去噪过程的反向传播。在基于状态的D4RL基准测试和基于视觉的OGBench任务上的实证结果表明，所提出的噪声空间方法……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种噪声空间动作值函数与噪声空间策略梯度（NSPG）方法，使扩散策略仅凭干净动作空间的值估计即可优化噪声潜变量，并通过扩散兼容的回归形式避免了通过去噪过程的反向传播，有效解决了扩散模型与离线强化学习结合的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a noisy-space action-value function and a noisy-space policy gradient (NSPG) that optimizes diffusion latents using only clean action-space value estimates, enabling a KL-regularized policy improvement in a diffusion-compatible regression form without backpropagation through the denoising process.
